Results.ReviewText: This was a gift for our son and he is very happy with it.
Results.Title: Charcoal king

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Very durable. Withstands weather outside.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I have never had a charcoal grill before - I had always had a gas grill. I absolutely LOVE this grill!!   My teenage sons love when I grill - I have had this grill about two weeks and have used it 8 times.  The size is perfect for my deck and it is easy to clean up.
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: This is my 7th Weber Grill. Gave one to a friend and my son took my last one. I wouldn’t have anything else. Easy to assemble, strong, durable and it simply works. Worth every penny. No need to say anything more.
Results.Title: Weber is the Industry Standard

Results.ReviewText: Upgrade from basic 22” charcoal grille. The previous model lasted 25 years... love ash can and temperature features
Results.Title: New Grille

Results.ReviewText:
I do like this grill. It seems expensive at first, and I admit that after feeling the quality of the stand I normally wouldn't pay this much for it... but, after using it as much as I have it is awesome. After looking at other grills, I just don't think that they have the same exterior coating that these grills do. It matters. For instance... mine , unfortunately, fell on the ground and the pavement didnt even scrape the serface. It is a thick, cured coating that other imitation grills do not have. It makes it worth the money. Duribility and functionality is the key Weber.

The ash sweeper is the best for not having to maintain the grill that often. All of the ash goes into the ash pot as promised and makes for the easiest clean-up of any grill/smoker. 

I installed a digital/wifi temp gage (for an additional $50) with temp probes. I would recommend this as when smoking, I have the lid spun around so that the exhaust damper is opposite my slow and sear... I would recommend the slow and sear by the way. 

I do love my wobbly weber and will be selling my pellet grill as a result.
Results.Title: I love it, but could use some improvement.

Results.ReviewText: My 3rd Weber Kettle—each lasting 10-15 years:  I splurged on this one.  I love the storage place for the ash — so will my neighbors!
Results.Title: 3rd Kettle retired - 2 by passing on to 2 kid

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for bringing this to our attention! This is not the quality we would expect on our grills. We have passed your feedback to our support team and they will be reaching via email shortly!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill my last one lasted 10 years. However I am only giving this one I just bought 3 stars because some of the coating is missing at the top vent and I’m afraid it will rust.
Results.Title: Great grill minor flaw

Results.ReviewText: I am on my 3rd grill in 33 years of weekly use. It will smoke one Turkey and is the right size for grilling at home.The coating on this grill seems as strong and hard as the earlier ones.  l  This grill does not have the the external cradle that lets the top slide to the rear for easy opening and closing. And, the vent is made of metal, without the insulator that was on my last grill. So, you can not change the vent opening once it is hot, without use of a fire glove or mitt.  The Weber is my go to grill for daily grilling when flavor and taste count.
Results.Title: Still the best design for bar-be-que

Results.ReviewText: Having a blast cooking on the grill!  The grill gives the food so much flavor.  I do recommend getting the Weber charcoal chimney ($20) to make sure the charcoal gets lite properly.  Also do not use lighter fluid on the charcoal if you do not have to.
Results.Title: Well worth the purchase

Results.ReviewText: I was 18 years old when I bought my1st charcoal grill. It was the original Weber Kettle grill. I was 34 years old when I had to get a new one. Most of my new ones were gifts and not a Weber. Some I bought because They were on sale. Some lasted 3 years and some lasted 5 and I was never very happy with the quality of other products. On my 53 birthday my wife gave me The 22” original kettle premium charcoal grill. There is nothing like a Weber grill. One of the few companies that still take pride in what they make. It is the perfect size and made to last. I should know. I had my share of other grills over the years. Trust me, if you want the perfect grill that will out last you expectations, this is the one to get. Money that is well spent for a grill that is well built.
Results.Title: Weber quality

Results.ReviewText: Everything is great except, on my grill, the installation of the legs was very difficult. They did not fit into the mounting holes until I filed them down. Frustrating.
Results.Title: Assembly make take longer then expected. Worth it.

Results.ReviewText:
This is my second one since I wore the old one out. Love the ease of use and the way it cooks 
!!!
Results.Title: Im on number 2

Results.ReviewText: Classic style charcoal grill with all the features expected from the Weber line of products.  Use it alongside my Weber Spirit and my Smokey Mountain Smoker.  All quality grills that make grilling food easy.
Results.Title: Love my Weber Charcoal Grill.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Done both direct and indirect cooking and work like a charm. Easy keeping temp for long duration cooks using the airflow charts. Outstanding.
Results.Title: 21 inch kettle bbq

Results.ReviewText: Timeless charcoal grill! If you like charcoal, you will love this grill. Perfect for family of 4
Results.Title: Timeless charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: I’ve tried charcoal grilling in the past with poor results, but this grill was easy to learn and has made some great meals for us.  So much content available online since this grill is so popular, makes it easy to learn to grill anything. Also, many accessories keep it interesting.
Results.Title: Favorite grill

Results.ReviewText: The grill is perfect for quick and small BBQ needs. I have BBQ-ed ribs, boston butt, burgers, veggies, chicken, and sausages. The attachments (I purchased them separately) also adds to the diversity of the grill. I plan to purchase a few more grills like this (in different colors). I haven't had any problems and enjoy the efficiency of a small grill as compared to other off-set smokers. I also have several larger smokers that I use for catering large events, but for quick backyard meals, I prefer to use my Original Weber!
Results.Title: Perfect for Everyday Backyard Grilling and Smoking

Results.ReviewText: This is the most versatile grill out there that does everything well. You can cook hot and fast, low and slow, smoke foods, the only limit is your imagination.
Results.Title: Best value in grills

Results.ReviewText: Great grill and outstanding craftsmanship. Makes barbecue easy and flavorful
Results.Title: Original Kettle

Results.ReviewText: The grill is amazing. I bought three gas grills in the past and two cheap charcoal grills. This grill beats them all. I also love the app and I recently bought the Weber Grilling book with tips, techniques and recipes which has taught me a lot about grilling. Thanks Weber!
Results.Title: Grill

Results.ReviewText: Not only is this a great grill but Weber is great to its customers.  My grill top was stolen, caught on my doorbell camera.  Yes, someone ran off with the top while it was hot and Weber replaced it for me.  I will forever share this experience.  Customer for life!
Results.Title: Great customer experience

Results.ReviewText: Perfect price point. And great quality. Temperature controlled
Results.Title: Great equipment. !!

Results.ReviewText: Put the lid on , and start cooking, no flare ups , best Grill ever , I use my Weber at every Texans home game!!!!
Results.Title: Tailgating best friend!!!

Results.ReviewText:
this replaces (augments?-i can't part with it!) my 15 year old unit. I really enjoy cooking on it,  especially using it as a smoker for ribs and pulled pork. I bought a second lower grate and sometimes place it on top of the first with rock spacers to raise the coals closer to the cooking grate if I'm searing a few steaks or pork chops without the lid.  Today I'm cooking 2 pork butts side by side. one on the new grill and the other on the 'broken in' unit. 
   My only nit-pick is the wheels are useless on my back lawn.  I find it easier to carry the grill.   I LOVE cooking on it.
Results.Title: premium charcoal grill 22 inch

Results.ReviewText: I miss the backside handle that was on my old model. It made it able to pick the whole grill up even when hot. I like the cutouts that show how open the bottom vents are. I wish the thermometer was down the side of the lid, closer to the grill rack surface for accuracy, and to see it from a distance.
Results.Title: Grill pros and cons.

Results.ReviewText: Large cooking surface, easy to control air flow into and out of kettle to change heat. It is a little tippy when you try to move it, if you aren't careful.
Results.Title: Premium kettle is just that!

Results.ReviewText:
I really like the hinge sides, lets me add coals or wood chips.
What I'd really like would be an 18 -20" extinsion to make this a smoker also. Wouldn't be all that hard.
Results.Title: Weber grill Smoker

Results.ReviewText: Great grill - no wonder been around so long - missed cooking with charcoal  nothing like it!
Results.Title: Back to Basics - Couldn’t be Better

Results.ReviewText: I am loving the Weber kettle. I have enjoyed everything I have cooked on it. It has all come out great.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Well built, easy to regulate temp, easy to clean, great engineering
Results.Title: Grade A

Results.ReviewText: The single greatest grill I have ever purchased, ever
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever

Results.ReviewText: This grill is amazing the only thing I should have bought was a charcoal basket thanks Weber
Results.Title: Awsome grill

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I’ve ever had! Works great. Easy to control the temp you need for whatever meat your cooking.
Results.Title: Awesome grill!

Results.ReviewText: I love my new kettle! It is very versatile and super easy to clean. I have used it at least once a week since purchased and have already smoked(indirect) a pork shoulder and a packer brisket(14.5 lb) on the kettle.  Glad I got it!
Results.Title: Proud Kettle Owner

Results.ReviewText: This grill is very versatile , I love to smoke on it . I actually bought 2 for the same reason.
Results.Title: Smoking on the Weber

Results.ReviewText: Hands down one of the best pits anyone could grill on! I’ve made 2 slabs of St. Louis ribs, a whole packer brisket with no issues.. holds heat perfectly!
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium Charcoal Grill 22”

Results.ReviewText: Great grill that holds even heat. Legs could use some improvement in regards to sturdiness. Overall a good buy and hope it outlast other grills.
Results.Title: Webber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Have had Webers for years. It will be hard to pull me away from the brand.  Constructive criticism - This new model is harder to work with than the last one we had. It has prongs that you squeeze to get the ash pan connected. For someone with carpal tunnel, it is difficult to attach. Also, it would be nice if the lid were hinged. It's hard to deal with sometimes. Or maybe a way to choose hinged or not. I challenge you to develop a cooking grate that does not rust in Florida within 3 months. :) Even with suggestions, this is a great grill. Weber is always quality. Worth every penny. We know it will last 3-5 years at least. Thank you!
Results.Title: Good grill - worth it!

Results.ReviewText:
Love to grill with one exception.  When it was newer, the inside paint of the lid burned away, falling in the food, ruining that meal.  This happened several times, until I buffed all the paint off the inside lid.  Cooking temperature was only 400°.

Not sure how I feel about recommending this to a friend, so I guess I have to answer, No.
Results.Title: Fair For One Reason

14402001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14402001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
